title: AutoNovo: Agentic Program Search Discovers Transferable Nucleic Acid Design Algorithms
abstract: arXiv:2610.16232v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In-silico optimization of nucleic acids relies on predictive oracles that imperfectly capture biological function, so sequences optimized against one model may exploit model-specific artifacts and fail to generalize to independent models. Recent studies have shown that not all designers generalize equally well to independent models. In this work, we use agentic program search to iteratively propose, execute, evaluate, and revise code for nucleic-acid designers. We describe the successful strategies used to prompt the search. AutoNovo designers achieved the best observed mean among the evaluated methods on 3/3 DNA-design tasks in terms of in-silico performance, and 6/6 transfer tasks in terms of independent models. The designers come from a family of discovered nucleic acid designers rather than a single universal best designer. We plan to release the resulting designers. These results are the first steps in creating nucleic acid design

translated_title: AutoNovo：智能体程序搜索发现可迁移的核酸设计算法
translated_abstract: 核酸的计算机（in-silico）优化依赖于预测“神谕”模型，而这些模型对生物功能的刻画并不完美，因此针对某一模型优化得到的序列可能会利用该模型特有的伪影，从而无法泛化到独立模型上。近期研究表明，并非所有设计器向独立模型泛化的能力都同样好。在这项工作中，我们利用智能体程序搜索来迭代地提出、执行、评估和修改核酸设计器的代码，并描述了用于引导搜索的成功策略。在所评估的方法中，AutoNovo 设计器在 3/3 的 DNA 设计任务上取得了最佳的计算机内平均性能，并在 6/6 的独立模型迁移任务上取得了最佳表现。这些设计器来自一族被自动发现的核酸设计器，而非单一的通用最佳设计器。我们计划发布所得的设计器。这些结果是创建核酸设计……
tldr: AutoNovo 利用智能体程序搜索自动迭代地发现核酸设计算法，其设计器在全部 DNA 设计任务和向独立模型迁移的任务上均取得了最佳表现，并形成一族可发布的设计器。
en_tdlr: AutoNovo uses agentic program search to iteratively discover nucleic acid design algorithms, whose designers achieve the best performance on all DNA design tasks and all transfer tasks to independent models, yielding a family of releasable designers.
